identity.title: Create v0.91.8 ADL Core Rearchitecture milestone and sprint

values.summary: Baseline the incumbent and successful replacements, author the full v0.91.8 package, seed a dependency-ordered issue wave, validate it, run bounded review, and publish through the normal workflow.

steps.action: Capture current milestone, architecture, source, and tracker truth
Author the full v0.91.8 milestone, feature, architecture, sprint, and issue-wave package
Create and verify v0.91.8 tracker routing and child issues
Run focused planning, YAML, link, placeholder, and diff validation
Run bounded subagent review and resolve actionable findings
Publish the setup PR and stop before merge

invariants: tracked edits occur only in the issue worktree
legacy code is behavioral evidence rather than the new architecture
implementation and test LoC are measured separately
no completion or proof claim precedes evidence
80 percent deletion is a fail-closed minimum
risks: the rearchitecture may collide with active v0.91.7 worktrees
overlapping capability families may inflate or double-count the baseline
issue seeding before architecture review may encode the wrong boundaries
planning may accidentally widen v0.92 scope
stop_conditions: primary checkout is dirty or not on main
current tracker truth reveals an existing equivalent milestone
mandatory planning validation fails without a bounded repair
review finds an unresolved scope or architecture blocker
